text_block_list.text:
—If told any wish could be granted,
what would one desire?

"Is it fame to go down in history?
Or perhaps, there are those who seek fortune."

However—what I, as a Trainer,
truly desire from the bottom of my heart is...
Guiding the Umamusume I train to the moment she grasps the glory of "World's Strongest."

text_block_list.name: Commentary Audio
text_block_list.text:
"This settles it completely!
The leader holds a 5-length lead—"

—However, to do that,
I must climb up to "that grand stage."
Clinging to the thought of "Someday, I will too," I kept waiting for that opportunity to arrive.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: "Oh no, oh no, I have to hurry to the gym!"

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
B-But it looks like Love-chan
isn't here yet...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Maru-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Ah... good morning, Love-chan.
U-Um, you see... From now on, to the gym...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...The gym? Come to think of it,
everyone's coming out of the classrooms. Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
Um... Sensei came by earlier
and said they had some big news or something...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A big discussion, huh... Fufu. I hope it's
something fun♪ Shall we go and find out anyway?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
It's the American Dream, everyone!
At the Breeders' Cup,
let us seize our dreams together!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Pay attention! In accordance with the URA's medium-to-long-term guidelines,
this is a new training and overseas expedition plan!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, we've also invited members of the press!
Give them a warm welcome, everyone!
Now then, Casino Drive, we're counting on you once more!
The news came out of the blue. I had heard there was an announcement regarding the URA, but...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Hello everyone.
I am Casino Drive. Nice to meet those of you who don't know me yet, but I'm an active student at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Due to various circumstances, I've been flying all over the place...
But today, I brought some wonderful news.
...Would you care to take on a challenge?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a challenge on an unprecedented scale.
Something no Japanese Umamusume has ever achieved.
A dream no Japanese Umamusume has ever grasped.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Won't you come claim it together with me?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I have come to personally hand
everyone the ticket to that future.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: It will be a long journey of two and a half years, but...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I guarantee the glory that awaits on the other side!
Our destination is—the grand festival...!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Where dreams from all across America...
no, from all across the world gather—

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
One of the most premium events in the world!
A true 'GⅠ Festival'!
And it's in America!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
On every track! Over every distance!
An event gathering Umamusume from around the world
to determine the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: That's—the BC!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (! World's... strongest...!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (...If it's on that scale, then surely—)

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text: (...Love-chan.)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Only a handful of contenders from Japan have ever dared to challenge an event so full of dreams.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"And there are no victors yet either.
It's what one might call a blue ocean!"
(Yes, which means—)

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: (That means a single "win" there has "value" far beyond mere numbers...!)

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
This project—the BC expedition team "DREAMS"—
is meant to break through this very state of affairs!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Gather those capable of competing globally, train them with a mid-to-long term vision, and build an elite team.
Then... we will achieve our very first BC victory!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (...A talent capable of taking on the world...!)
choice_data_list: (A training team to conquer the BC...!)

text_block_list.name: Veteran Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I see, quite a splendid passion.
...Regardless of whether it's feasible or not, that is.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I understand very well how difficult that path is.
Perhaps better than anyone here.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why I seek members who share my aspirations and can help carry us to victory!"

text_block_list.name: Cool Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Dreaming is all well and good.
But even famous seniors who ran in tons of GⅠs
couldn't stand a chance...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...The BC is way too much of an away game for us.
We can't just casually throw our hat into the ring..."
Indeed, it is a fact that no challenger from Japan has ever conquered the BC.
If she can take the world title... it'll be the crowning achievement of <chrname>'s career.
After the assembly, I called out to <chrname> as she was heading back to the classroom. Then—

"She gave a look as though she could see
right through everything I was thinking."

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"I kind of expected this, but—
Still no response on the application form, huh."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Even after advertising it so boldly.
As expected, even veteran Trainers hesitate...

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Come to think of it, when I took on the challenge, everyone around me was rather hesitant about the overseas expedition as well—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Nwoh!?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
What?
Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Y... You are none other than—
Trainer <username>, are you not?
choice_data_list: Please put me on the Breeders' Cup expedition team!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Or so they say, but what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: ...I believe I also mentioned the application form, though.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
……Hehe. You don't have to input it right now.
Instead, please tell me here.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
The reason why you'd barge in out of nowhere
just to reach for the American Dream.

"Ever since I first learned about overseas racing,
――the BC has always been my dream."

A dream festival consisting of over 10 international GⅠ races
held to crown the "World's Strongest."
"Distinct from the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe and Dubai GⅠs, its unique sense of speed and scale captivates fans, propelling many Umamusume to stardom."
choice_data_list: Yet the victor has always been from a powerhouse like the US or Europe.

text_block_list.text:
"—If I can challenge this wall alongside my Umamusume and... emerge victorious.
If I can witness the moment she grasps glory."

With that desire in heart,
she waited for an opportunity that might come at any time.

And then, an Umamusume who once challenged the wall—
Casino Drive—appeared with a ticket to take on the challenge.
In that moment, I was certain.
choice_data_list: Now is the only time to seize this chance!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
So—unable to sit still, you barged
straight into the Chairwoman's office, is that it?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Then let me confirm one thing. Do you not doubt the feasibility, like that reporter did?
Do you have no hesitation facing the world's greatest?
choice_data_list: Yes! If I can team up with you, since you have local experience!

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: On-site experience... Heh, I see. It might seem like an unassuming factor at first glance... but that's what you're focusing on, huh?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Casino Drive.
Personally, I think it's a viable option—what say you?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Shall we bet the outcome of this two-and-a-half-year project... on Trainer <username>?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The chips needed to gamble against the world
are intelligence... and passion, after all.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: "I nominate him as the Trainer for the BC Expedition Project, 'DREAMS'!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: "I nominate her as the Trainer for the BC Expedition Project, 'DREAMS'!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Maru-chan. To deliver "love" across the whole world...
I'm thinking of taking on an overseas challenge, too♪

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
S-So you really are aiming for the BC. Ever since
I heard about your overseas trip... I had a feeling.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, as expected of my childhood friend♪ You see right through me.
So you see... I'd be really happy if you joined in too, Maru-chan♡

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
M-Me...? ...Y-Yeah, okay.
If it's helping Love-chan, I think I can do my best.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Gathering the talented to aim for the pinnacle of the world.
If that is what I seek—
that "somewhere other than here"...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this very path... is what was
meant to guide me toward my true way of being.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Heh! Told ya not to worry.
...Huh, English?
Come on... I still got two and a half years, so it's fine!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway—I'm definitely going to America
and becoming the best in the world!"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Sowwyy, I've got plans today. An interesting rumor's started making the rounds, too.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: What's that... wait, could it be—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: A・me・ri・ca・Ex・pe・di・tion☆

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"—So, the Umamusume you train
will also be joining the team, then."
choice_data_list: Yes, they're fully on board, of course.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
That's reassuring. The BC we're aiming for is the year after next.
We'll want to get things in motion as soon as possible.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"The BC is hosted at racecourses across the United States,
rotating locations each year.
While the venue for the year after next is currently undecided――"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to decide on our target race.
The race conditions are generally the same,
and our interim goals will change accordingly.

Afterward, drawn by the talk about "DREAMS,"
several other Umamusume came over—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No matter how great the trial...
I shall surely overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Heh. America or wherever, doesn't matter. Bottom line is blowin' past everyone, right?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's win this... and deliver "love" to the whole world.
To everyone in our fan community ♡
And to all our future fans we've yet to meet ♪

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"You got it♪ I'll do everything I can
to help Love-chan become number one in the world☆"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ "No one has won, no one can win.
Therefore, winning is impossible"—conventional wisdom like that...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
This is totally "worth turning upside down"!♪ 
Now then, let's draw up an exciting roadmap together!

And so, the expedition team formed under the name
"DREAMS"—

The days of challenging the "World's Strongest"
and seizing the American Dream were about to begin!
